answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for *shadow work* and *spiritual practice*, the strongest options in your results are **Jung Platform**, **Udemy shadow-work courses**, and **Insight Timer** for guided, practice-based learning.[6][10][5]

- **Jung Platform — Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work / Shadow courses**  
  Best if you want the most *psychologically grounded* approach. The platform offers an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work, plus a broader set of shadow courses and talks that cover the personal and collective shadow, relationships, dreams, and practical tools.[12][10][6]

- **Udemy — Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self Certification**  
  Best if you want a structured, beginner-friendly course focused on healing, integration, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening. The course description explicitly ties shadow work to spiritual development.[3]

- **Insight Timer — Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing And Growth**  
  Best if you want a more *meditation-centered* and contemplative format. The course focuses on uncovering and healing hidden parts of yourself that affect your life.[5]

- **Udemy — Shadow Work Course and Workbook**  
  Best if you want a more practice-heavy option. This course includes exercises, meditations, prayers, and spiritual practices for introspective shadow work and spiritual transformation.[14]

- **Udemy — Shadow Work Essentials / Do Your Own Shadow Work: Beginning to Advanced Practices**  
  Best if you want a range of techniques and a more skills-based path. These courses focus on uncovering shadow parts, reducing reactivity, and moving from beginner to more advanced practice.[7][15]

- **Centre of Excellence — Shadow Mastery Diploma Course**  
  Best if you want a diploma-style format and a broader self-development structure. It is explicitly framed as a shadow mastery course with exercises.[1]

If your priority is **spiritual practice plus depth psychology**, I’d rank them like this:

| Best for | Course/platform |
|---|---|
| Jungian depth and theory | **Jung Platform** |
| Guided spiritual integration | **Udemy: Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** |
| Meditation-based practice | **Insight Timer** |
| Exercises and workbook-style learning | **Udemy: Shadow Work Course and Workbook** |
| Beginner-to-advanced technique building | **Udemy: Shadow Work Essentials / Do Your Own Shadow Work** |

A practical note: the results show several Udemy and marketplace-style courses with overlapping themes, so the best choice depends more on **teaching style** than on a single universally “best” course.[3][7][14][15] If you want, I can also narrow these down into **best free options**, **best for beginners**, or **best for Jungian/psychology-based study**.
